Welcome to NS Health – your hub for real results with bioadaptive impulse therapy.

Here you’ll find expert how-to videos, treatment protocols, and client success stories using the sanakey, physiokey, and medkey devices — including powerful applications in Key Equine Therapy.

We share:
🌀 Self-treatment tutorials for common pain conditions
📘 Device tips, program walkthroughs & accessory guides
✨ Stories from real people finding lasting relief
🐴 Real-world results from equine therapy 

Whether you’re a health practitioner, therapist, or home user, our channel will help you get the most from your Key Therapy device — for pain relief, recovery, and performance.

👉 Learn more at www.nshealth.com.au | www.keytraining.online

Subscribe and activate the bell for new protocols, case studies, and updates from the world of adaptive pain therapy.
